---
description: Implement work item.
agent: agent
argument-hint: "GitHub issue URL or #number, optionally followed by session constraints"
---


Follow the implement-work-item and work-item-intake skills and repository instructions.
Load the referenced work item through the configured provider MCP or authenticated GitHub CLI; do not guess its contents.
Read `docs/development/github-project-workflow.md`, check the linked Project #2 item and maintain its status/evidence during authorized work. Tim owns priority and Ready authorization; respect existing session authorization.
Normalize acceptance criteria, preserve current edits, check branch, identify open questions and plan the implementation.
Use the review triggers and separate approval gates in the baseline. Do not create a branch, commit, push or PR without the corresponding approval.
Conclude with implemented criteria, actual checks, unresolved findings and the next approval request.
